title: Slip shod to the point of obvious return
text: Slip shod to the point of obvious return. This was made out of alignment.  Didn’t even take the hangers out of the box to try it.  Something told me not to try this product due to the unusual process by which it it supposed to be set up.  Wish I had paid attention. My advice? Pay the lousy $10- extra and get one of the white ones by a couple of other companies that simply press on one time with the palms and stay on.  Got mine today and it is very well made and very sturdy.
